decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those specified in the application and accompanying plans.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, 1/6, 2/6, 3/6, 4/6, 5/6, and 6/6, received: 1 December 2016. Proposed Block Plan received: 17 January 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, and non-opening, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side and rear walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The building hereby permitted shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of 4 Elmwood Road, Chiswick W4 3DZ, the building shall not be used as a bedroom, kitchen or living room and shall not be occupied as separate or ancillary residential accommodation
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding at the rear garden of the house
